resources.string: A 35B model on your phone: BigMoeOnEdge keeps the always-used weights in memory and reads each word\'s experts from storage. Slow, but a real 35B.
Not in this build: run scripts/build-lab-engines.sh, then rebuild
Not on the phone. Copy it over USB: adb push {{file}} {{path}}
✓ BOAR answers with this model now. Pick another one in Models to switch back.

The first answer loads the model (a minute or more). Each answer then takes minutes, and the phone gets warm: turn on the Debug log to see speed and heat. Adaptive routing is skipped while it\'s selected.
🦣 Too big for this phone\'s memory: Big Boar can run it, slower.
